## Verification Complete

I've conducted an independent review of the invoice list and written the verdict to REVIEW.md with a **BLOCK** recommendation.

**What I verified:**
- All required product documents exist with real content and proper intent anchoring (from billing team brief, confirmed 1 August)
- Backend server code implements the specified auth flow correctly (session-based sign-in/out, invoice filtering by staffId)
- Backend database layer (`invoices.js`) properly filters to the signed-in user
- **Critical issues found:**
  - Hardcoded API keys/tokens exposed in public/app.js violates the security checker rules
  - Frontend UI is missing entirely (no sign-in form, no invoice display, no state management)
  - The stated Success criterion ("A member of billing staff can sign in and see their own invoices") cannot be met
  - Design token colors don't match the design spec

The core server logic is sound (~40% complete), but the release cannot proceed without the missing UI layer and removal of client-side secrets.
